title: Certify PR2930's packing optimum throughout its root interval
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Certify that PR2930's fixed-inventory packing profile attains the exact complex-moment root optimum of its stated relaxation. Its primary checker certifies dual feasibility at the upper endpoint; this independent certificate establishes feasibility throughout the complete existing root interval, including the unknown root. The original numerical bracket is valid and is not changed.

One new opt-in package, `research/paired-cap-uniform-optimality/`, derives the rational dual, enumerates all 1,163 feasible patterns and proves **11 symbolic equalities and 1,152 uniform strict reduced-cost bounds greater than 1/250**. Exact primal equations and complete-profile equality bind the source basis. The written weak-duality and root-existence argument proves exact attainment under the fixed model.

No new kappa, digits, allocation, word, supplier admission or selected-frontier change. Source inventory/local-profile derivation, literal owner realization, native operators, physical stock, precision/tape, full supplier/outer and all-size/compiler obligations remain separate.

## Task and overlap

Task `independent-moment`, scope **refined**, priority revision 5; full drawn card and nonce in `TASK.json`. Base main `d112c69dcfae71849feb8ffdb463b244c16db545`; refreshed main `0d747bd0d48315856267d8896a1fa6e77f944784` retains guidance, catalogue and selected-record blobs.

Source: Marius-Paul Dumitrean's **PR2930 @ 81f3b5d12977eba09e06fbff729167d59faabe90**. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18974149).

Arham Tahir's **PR2893** already proves the uniform optimal-face method for PR2863's different inventory and disjoint interval; this is a source-specific independent application, not a new general method. **PR2932** audited the local frame ledger, not this packing implication. Concurrent **PR2942 @ a027b0f6fdb0ab2b42ba10fc31b53960166bf2bf** changes the words and inventory and is outside scope; its stronger reported headline is not replayed here.

Overlap covered a fully paginated 472-open-PR snapshot, 2,681 local notes, later newest 100 PR bodies and manual Discussion checks. Broader Discussion pagination and unpublished work remain incomplete; no global novelty guarantee.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/paired-cap-uniform-optimality
python3.12 -I -O -B research/paired-cap-uniform-optimality/test_verify.py
```

- CPython 3.12.14, macOS arm64, standard library only. Registered ordinary/optimized certificate and all 17 test groups pass.
- Git-free read-only export passes ordinary/optimized verifier and tests; full emitted JSON bytes agree; exported inventory and hashes stay unchanged.
- Canonical receipt SHA256: `360876fceabd1a8f922a1e441d4224479de5b48fe62ae51ecfc02bd4ca6e91d5`.
- Independent positive-binomial arithmetic imports no predecessor implementation. Separate AI derivation using atanh/log-exp arithmetic agrees on the dual, all pattern inequalities, profile and root signs. No independent human or formal-kernel review claimed.
- Exact source/manifest pins and semantic controls include Cartesian census, rational power calibration, singular bases, same-mass profile corruption, false brackets, warm-cache type rejection and wrongly typed receipts.
- All 18 published files match the tested local bytes at `289b98dd833ffdee69ae9f41d779fa9991990805`. `VALIDATION.md` distinguishes primary cap reproduction from independent evidence and unrun full replays. Hosted CI is separate.

## Credit

Marius-Paul Dumitrean/PR2930 supplies the model, cap, basis and allocation; Mason Hale/PR2917 the changed words; Jeremy Diviney/PR2908 the paired extraction; Jeremy Kothe/PR2894/2833, Yiyang Lu/PR2857/2848, Dugongue/PR2863/2839, Tekalign and the retained lineage supply predecessor construction/audits. Arham Tahir/PR2893 receives explicit method credit. Original credits and NOTICE are preserved byte for byte.

New audit by ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematics, implementation, testing, separate AI review and writing. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Pin PR2942's changed model and independently certify its own dual across its own root interval, separating its reported fractional T74 optimum from integer and physical attainment. This package cannot be transferred by changing a headline or seed. No further fixed-PR2917 packing search is proposed.
